theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ), ∃ P : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n), ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, MvPolynomial.coeff d P.val = if d 0 + d 1 = n then a (d 0) else 0
